subject: Create Layer 2 Pydantic I/O models
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/models/relationships.py` with Pydantic input/output models for Layer 2 relationship discovery tools.

Models to create:

**Output models:**
- `ForeignKeyInfo`: constraint_name, source_schema, source_table, source_columns (list[str]), target_schema, target_table, target_columns (list[str]), delete_rule
- `ForeignKeysOutput`: table_name, schema_name, outgoing (list[ForeignKeyInfo]), incoming (list[ForeignKeyInfo]), outgoing_count, incoming_count
- `JoinStep`: from_schema, from_table, from_column, to_schema, to_table, to_column, constraint_name, direction (outgoing/incoming)
- `JoinPath`: steps (list[JoinStep]), length, sql_example (str)
- `FindJoinPathOutput`: from_table, to_table, paths (list[JoinPath]), path_count

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] FK model captures both direction (outgoing/incoming) with full details
- [ ] JoinPath includes generated SQL JOIN example
- [ ] Paths sorted by length (shortest first)
- [ ] All models serializable for MCP transport

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Cross-schema foreign keys: schema fields populated on both sides
- [ ] Empty FK lists serialize correctly

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Model instantiation with valid FK data
• Unit: Model serialization to dict/JSON

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.2, 9.2
